payload.notes: AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Al-Bi'that khums form, نکتہ 34 — Al-Bi'that khums form: نکتہ 34. States (own words): Taxed money mixed with new income: spend with the intention of using the new year's income. Precaution as worded: AS WORDED IN THE FORM. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 563 — Khums year of someone with an occupation. States (own words): The year of anyone with an occupation (trader, employee, farmer, teacher, worker…) ends one year after starting work; at that point khums is due on everything existing and not spent on needs, even income of the previous day. No separate year per profit (except several occupations, 565). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: named (first year starts with work); missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 564 — Who counts as having an occupation. States (own words): Someone whose earned income over the year is a significant amount relative to yearly expenses (examples: 5% is not, 25% is); when doubtful, treated as not having an occupation and may keep a separate year per income. Conditions: Significant share of yearly expenses. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: The 5% and 25% figures are examples, not thresholds: the person's status is asked as a confirmation.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 565 — Several different occupations. States (own words): Different kinds of occupation with separate accounts may each have their own year if each yields a significant income; a minor second occupation follows the main one's year. Conditions: Separate accounts; Each significant. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Separate yearly cycles need date capability.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 566 — New activity of the same kind. States (own words): A second activity of the same kind (another shop, other crops) cannot have its own year. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 567 — Seasonal earners. States (own words): Seasonal earners whose yearly earned income is significant count as having an occupation: one year for all income. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 568 — Income from capital given to others or rented property. States (own words): A significant income from mudaraba, bank investment under Islamic contracts, or renting property makes the person count as having an occupation. Conditions: Significant income. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 569 — Incidental income of someone with an occupation. States (own words): No separate year for incidental income (a one-off sale, gifts). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 570 — Incidental income with two yearly cycles. States (own words): May add it to either cycle, never a separate one. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 571 — Exact end of the khums year. States (own words): The year ends at the same hour work began, one year later; remaining income may not be used after that moment. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: GUIDANCE. Open: The calculator works by date; the hour is noted for the person.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 572 — No known start date. States (own words): Someone with an occupation and no known start who settles with a jurist or his agent and pays: the payment time becomes the khums year point. Conditions: Settlement with a jurist. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: named (year point set at first payment); missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Settlement itself is with a jurist: recorded, not computed.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 573 — Khums year without an occupation. States (own words): People without an occupation (supported by state or others, incidental income) pay on what exceeds the year's expenses one year after owning each income; may keep a separate year per income. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Per-income yearly cycles need date capability.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 574 — Start of each income's year. States (own words): For people without an occupation, each income's year starts when it is owned, not when it is converted (e.g. into goods). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 575 — End of each income's year. States (own words): Once a year passes from owning that income, it may not be used for needs until khums is paid. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: GUIDANCE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 576 — Retiring or stopping work mid-year. States (own words): Keeps the occupation rules until that year ends; afterwards, if without work, the rules for people without an occupation apply. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 577 — Calendar of the khums year. States (own words): Solar, lunar or Gregorian year may be used. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 578 — Changing the khums year. States (own words): Moving it later: assess and pay at the old date, then again at the new date for the months between. Moving it earlier: assess and pay at the new date. Same with a settlement taking khums as a debt. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: A transitional short year needs date capability.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 579 — Lunar to solar year. States (own words): Allowed before the lunar year ends; once ended, khums is due and cannot wait for the solar date, but the new year may be solar. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: GUIDANCE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 580 — Doubt whether the year has passed. States (own words): May assume the year has not passed (e.g. lost records); but someone at fault (no accounts, negligence) settles with a jurist proportionate to probability, by obligatory precaution. Precaution as worded: MIXED. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: relevant; missed-year: relevant. Calculator use: STOP. Open: Fault and probability are judged with a jurist: stop and refer.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 581 — Death during the year. States (own words): Spending until death is exempt; khums on the rest is due immediately; funeral costs are not deducted. Heirs need not pay for one who deliberately never paid and left no will. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: not named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: OUT_OF_SCOPE. Open: The calculator assesses living persons.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 582 — Paying during the year. States (own words): May pay when income arrives or delay to year end; if it will certainly remain unneeded, pay at once by obligatory precaution. Precaution as worded: MIXED. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: GUIDANCE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 584 — Earned and unearned income. States (own words): Earned income includes trade, industry, farming, employment and salaries, labour, renting out property, hunting, gathering free things. Unearned includes gifts, prizes, rewards and bequests. Both owe khums if not spent on the year's needs. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 585 — Receiving a gift already taxed or inherited. States (own words): Such a gift is the recipient's income of the year; khums if it remains unspent at year end. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 596 — Two kinds of mu'nah. States (own words): Khums falls on income after deducting the year's mu'nah: costs of earning income, and the year's personal and family expenses. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 597 — Costs of earning income. States (own words): All spending to earn income with nothing received in return (wages of staff, porters, brokers, shop rent, taxes…) is deducted; if paid from a loan, the debt is deducted. Wear on taxed or inherited tools of trade counts too (example: a car bought from taxed money losing value through rental use). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Depreciation of tools needs start and year-end values (valuation capability).

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 598 — The year's personal and family expenses: three groups and five conditions. States (own words): Consumables; durable items used for their benefit (home, furniture, clothes, women's gold jewellery, computer, books, vehicle…); running costs (gifts, charity, guests, pilgrimage or leisure travel, vows and kaffarah, repaying debts for family expenses, children's wedding or education, medical care, diyah paid, compensation paid). Exempt only if: (1) paid from the year's income, not income whose year passed unpaid; (2) customary and within status; (3) not extravagant or unlawful; (4) for consumables and durables, customarily needed during the year; (5) consumed, used, or spent before year end. Conditions: Five conditions. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Status, extravagance and customary need are the person's own determinations (asked as confirmations).

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 599 — Unlawful or extravagant spending. States (own words): Spending that is unlawful or extravagant owes khums; spending beyond status owes khums on the excess; even meritorious spending abnormal for the person owes khums on the excess by obligatory precaution. Precaution as worded: MIXED. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: The excess beyond status is not computable by the calculator: asked or stopped.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 600 — Criterion of status. States (own words): Status is set by custom (family, education, job, marital status, children, income, social standing, place and time), within the limits of no extravagance and nothing unlawful; the person judges the facts. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: not named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: GUIDANCE. Open: Supports asking the person to confirm 'within status'.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 601 — Doubt whether an item is within status. States (own words): When doubting whether an item is within status, khums on the doubtful amount is due; if previously within status and doubt arises later, it is treated as within status. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: The doubtful amount is the person's own figure.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 602 — Doubt whether an item was used. States (own words): At year end, doubt whether an item bought or gifted was used means khums is due, unless the item's mere existence counts as mu'nah (605, 612, 614). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 603 — Left-over consumables. States (own words): Worthless remains owe nothing; valuable remains owe nothing if the smallest available size was bought, otherwise they owe khums; same for gifts. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 604 — Valuation of unused items at year end. States (own words): Left-over consumables and unused items bought from the year's income are valued at the year-end price (recommended precaution: purchase price if it fell). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs year-end value input (valuation capability).

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 605 — Unused items that were needed. States (own words): Items not used before year end owe khums even if needed, except: buying ahead is customary for one's status, or buying later when needed would be impossible or cause unusual hardship. Exceptions: Customary to buy ahead; Later purchase impossible or very hard. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Both exceptions are the person's own determinations.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 608 — Sets sold only together. States (own words): If part of a needed set (books, dishes) is used during the year, the rest is exempt. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 609 — Items given to family to use without ownership. States (own words): Exempt if customary for the person's status (e.g. jewellery for a wife's use, a book for a child). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 610 — Items for both personal and work use. States (own words): Exempt if personal use is substantial; if the item is customarily a work item, khums on the price difference above a personal-use equivalent; if personal use is minor, all is liable. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Price of a personal-use equivalent is the person's own figure.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 612 — Trousseau and marriage savings. States (own words): Gradual trousseau purchases within status and custom are exempt; bought after the year passed, or gradually without need, they owe khums. Same for a son's future household items. Money set aside or saved for a trousseau, household items or wedding costs owes khums at year end even if the conditions hold. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE. Open: Savings for marriage: liable.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 613 — Trousseau used for other needs. States (own words): Exempt trousseau later used for other needs stays exempt; if sold, the rules of selling mu'nah apply (632–633). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 614 — Building a home gradually; home savings. States (own words): Materials and land for a home built over years owe khums at each year end, unless gradual building is the only and customary way for the person and not doing so is a shortfall in status; money saved for a future home owes khums even then. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: The 'only way and customary' condition is the person's determination.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 615 — Home rented out to pay its price. States (own words): A home bought within status and rented out to pay off its price owes khums at year end after deducting its debt, unless that is the only customary way to own a home. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 616 — First home rented out, a larger second home bought. States (own words): The first home owes nothing. The second: liable if the first was sufficient; liable up to the first home's current value if the first was too small; exempt if the move was for other reasons (location, neighbours, distance to work). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs the first home's current value; reason for moving is the person's own answer.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 620 — State subsidies paid by bank transfer (Shetab). States (own words): Subsidies paid by interbank transfer into a household head's account are not liable until withdrawn in cash; once withdrawn and owned they are income of that year, liable if unspent at year end. Conditions: Paid by Shetab transfer; Withdrawn in cash. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Specific to Iran's Shetab network: other payment routes stop for review.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 621 — Subsidies paid into an investment account. States (own words): If the person appointed the bank as agent for Islamic investment and it invested the funds during the year, the invested sum is income of the year, treated as business capital (640). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 624 — Insurance premiums and payouts. States (own words): Premiums paid from the year's income for customary insurance within status are exempt; payouts received by Shetab transfer follow the subsidy rule (620–621); death payouts to named beneficiaries are not inheritance. Conditions: Customary and within status; Payout route. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Payouts by other routes stop for review.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 625 — Investment-type insurance. States (own words): Follows the rules of bank investment (676–677); on death, principal and profit to that date are part of the estate. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 626 — Pension fund contributions and pension payments. States (own words): A pension contract (share of monthly salary paid to a fund; fund pays bonus or pension by transfer) follows the insurance rule (624). Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (sis-620); Shetab-only route.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 632 — Selling an item of mu'nah after its first year. States (own words): A rise in value of items in use is not liable; if sold after the first year, the original price is exempt; the rise is exempt if received without exchange (gift), but if bought from the year's income it is income of the year of sale. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs purchase price and sale price.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 633 — Selling an item of mu'nah within its first year. States (own words): If sold within the first year and the price stays unspent at year end: original price liable by obligatory precaution; the rise liable (fatwa if bought, obligatory precaution if gifted). Precaution as worded: MIXED. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 634 — Need for an item ending. States (own words): If need ends after the first year, no khums; if it ends within the first year, khums by precaution; seasonal items set aside are not liable. Precaution as worded: MIXED. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 636 — Spending from income while having taxed property. States (own words): May spend the year's income on needs instead of taxed or inherited property; but if an existing taxed or inherited item already meets the need (e.g. an inherited house that suffices), buying another from income is not mu'nah. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 637 — Former mu'nah sold to buy a shop. States (own words): A home or car used as mu'nah and sold (same price or less) after its year to buy a shop: the shop owes nothing, and a new home or car may be bought from income. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 638 — Taxed money mixed with income. States (own words): Intention has no effect on withdrawals from a mixed fund: jointly owned shares are drawn proportionally; otherwise drawn first from the year's income. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs tracking of taxed vs untaxed balances.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 639 — Taxed money and income owed by another (e.g. bank). States (own words): When collecting part of a debt, both sides must intend which share it is; for state or semi-state banks the account holder's intention suffices; otherwise proportional. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 640 — Business capital: basic and expansion. States (own words): Basic capital (the minimum needed to live within status) bought from the year's income is not mu'nah and owes khums, unless paying it, even by settlement and instalments over years, would make life within status impossible or unbearably hard or force unsuitable work; then not required (but any part that can be paid is due). Expansion capital owes khums. Conditions: Paid from the year's income. Exceptions: Hardship exception for basic capital. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: relevant (capital held at first assessment); missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Hardship is the person's own determination: asked, never judged.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 641 — Shops, premises and tools. States (own words): The capital rule (640) applies to shops, factories, tools, transport vehicles, machines. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 645 — Rise in value of taxed trading goods. States (own words): If taxed or inherited property held for trade rises and can be sold, the market rise owes khums at year end even if unsold. Conditions: Held for trade; Sellable. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs year-end market value (valuation capability).

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 646 — Rise in value of taxed non-trading property. States (own words): Received without exchange (inheritance): the rise is never liable, even after sale. Bought: not liable until sold; on sale, the purchase price is exempt and the rise is income of the year of sale. Gifted property taxed from itself: rise exempt; taxed from other money: four-fifths as unexchanged, one-fifth as exchanged. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. Calculator use: RULE_WITH_STOP. Open: Needs acquisition route, purchase price and sale price.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 647 — Rise caused by inflation. States (own words): Where a rise would be liable, liability for a rise caused by inflation is problematic: obligatory precaution, where the real gain is not clear after the currency's loss of value; the person may refer to the next most learned mujtahid who holds otherwise. The part above inflation is a gain. Precaution as worded: OBLIGATORY_PRECAUTION. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: relevant; missed-year: relevant (past dues and inflation). Calculator use: STOP. Open: Inflation adjustment needs a scholar: stop and refer.

AI research sheet(s), own words, not the ruling's text; not verified by a scholar. Jami' 648 — Trading goods bought on credit. Conditions: Paid by Shetab transfer; Withdrawn in cash. Precaution as worded: FATWA. Assessment types named by the text — annual: named; first-time: not named; missed-year: not named. payload.conclusion: DRAFT prepared by AI from explicit text only — not verified by a scholar. Annual assessment: one-fifth of the year's earnings and gains that exceed the year's living expenses (Tawdih 1769, 1770). Costs of earning reduce only the income they earn (1791; Jami' 597); a loss in one kind of work does not offset another (1790, obligatory precaution). Living expenses within status and spent from the year's income are deducted (1792; Jami' 598); unpaid debts for the year's needs are deducted under the conditions of Jami' 704. Tax paid is mu'nah, even for past years' tax (Jami' 848). Khums may be paid during the year (Jami' 582); a fifth paid on this year's income fully taxes what it was paid on (Jami' 721), so it is subtracted from the amount due; khums of an earlier year paid from this year's income is not deducted. Collectable receivables that are income owe khums at the year end even if not demanded; for one that cannot be collected now the person may pay when it is collected or now on its present cash value (Jami' 715); a loan of khums-paid money owes nothing (716). The khums year is one year (563); moving it later is done by assessing at the old date first, so a longer period stops for review, while a shorter transitional period is assessed as it is (578). Several occupations with separate accounts, or a person without an occupation, may keep separate years (565, 573, 574); how living expenses are borne across them is not stated (review). Taxed or inherited stock held for trade: its year-end rise above the last taxed value is liable even if unsold (645, 653, 670); a rise that is only inflation is an obligatory precaution (647: review). The unpaid, not yet deducted part of a debt for a home, vehicle or furniture still in use is deducted from later years' income (704; Q&A 7). Shares bought with taxed money for trade: a sellable rise is income even if unsold (680); not for trade: not until sold (681). Mahr and diyah received are not liable (586; Q&A 4). Premiums for customary insurance within status are mu'nah (624); investment-type insurance follows bank investment (625: review); insurance money unspent at year end is liable (Q&A 4), and a payout by interbank transfer not yet withdrawn follows the subsidy rule (620: review). Unpaid mahr of a marriage in this khums year may be deducted (704 example; Q&A 27).
payload.explanation: Encoded as one Rule Builder rule (annual surplus). Counted: salary, business, freelance and rental income, bonuses, gifts, charity received, inheritance counted as a gain, pensions. Gifts, charity and inheritance in kind stop for review (whether an item kept or used counts as spent is not stated). Inheritance under valid rules that was expected or from the father or son is excluded (1771); known unpaid khums of the deceased stops for review (1772: which value is taxed is not stated). Khums or zakat received by an entitled person is excluded (1776). Pensions funded by salary deductions that were a loan stop for review (office Q&A 4). Spending paid from income whose year had passed is not deducted (Jami' 598, condition 1); spending beyond status stops (599: only the excess is liable, which the calculator cannot compute). Debts are deducted only when confirmed for this year's needs, arising in this year after starting work, and unpaid (Jami' 704); debts for lasting needs first used in an earlier year stop (carry-over is not supported). Several kinds of work, or lines with separate accounts, with a loss stop for review (1790). Holdings at year end: things bought with this year's income and still held are counted at their year-end value, and the price paid for them is deducted, so items used or needed during the year net to zero (mu'nah) while unused items, investments, business stock and tools are taxed at year-end value (Tawdih 1797, 1798, 1812; Jami' 604, 605, 682). Business capital that would cause unbearable hardship stops for review (Jami' 640: anything payable must still be paid); land for one's future home stops (Jami' 614 conditions are the person's circumstances). Sales of property: the gain (sale price minus purchase cost, never below zero and never offsetting other income) is income of the year of sale (Jami' 632, 646b; Tawdih 1787); property received without payment and not kept for trade is excluded (646a); business stock, living items sold within their first year (633, obligatory precaution), gifts taxed from other money (646), items bought with income whose year passed (735), and any sale at a loss stop for review. Investment returns: definite bank profit under an agency contract and dividends received are income of the year (Jami' 677a, 683.1); payments 'on account' before profit is confirmed are not yet liable (677b–c, 683.4); bank profit without an agency contract stops (678: unknown-owner property). Decision 81 (form): valuation by how an item was paid for (Tables 1–2), loan-bought items counted at the part repaid, mixed exempt money (note 11), items used for both life and work (note 22), waqf (note 10), dowry (notes 7–8), Hajj savings (note 19), provident fund, gratuity and leave encashment (note 9), partnership (note 5), loans given (note 29), animals, crops and stock at the khums date (Table 3, notes 27–28), and the form's exemptions.
